docker_compose_file:
# Attested Vaultwarden on SEV-SNP measured direct boot (Servury Blackbox).
#
# This file has the shape of a compose file so that the verifier's Images
# and Config checks read it unchanged, but NO container runtime interprets
# it. deploy/sev-snp/gen-config.py turns it, at image build time, into the
# files /init reads inside the initrd:
#   services.<name>.environment  ->  /etc/attested-vw/<name>.env
#   configs.caddyfile.content    ->  /etc/attested-vw/Caddyfile
# and wraps it into app-compose.json, whose SHA-256 is on the measured
# kernel command line. /init starts each service as the `user` given here,
# with exactly that environment. `image` names the digest-pinned upstream
# image the binary was copied from (deploy/sev-snp/Dockerfile); nothing is
# pulled at run time. The attestation sidecar is built from source and is
# described in the `sidecar` member of app-compose.json instead.
#
# Settings follow deploy/dstack/docker-compose.template.yml (2026.11.4).
name: attested-vaultwarden-snp

services:
  vaultwarden:
    image: docker.io/vaultwarden/server@sha256:4fe17f415f90087377d37c755e0ea3cf189dcc6794e49cdd2a9adbb4937d9e1f # 1.37.5
    user: "1000:1000"
    environment:
      DOMAIN: "https://snp.facundo.dev"
      ROCKET_ADDRESS: "127.0.0.1"
      ROCKET_PORT: "8080"
      ROCKET_PROFILE: "release"
      WEB_VAULT_FOLDER: "/web-vault"
      # The data folder is a tmpfs: THE VAULT IS LOST WHEN THE VM STOPS.
      # Vaultwarden refuses to start on volatile storage without this.
      DATA_FOLDER: "/data"
      I_REALLY_WANT_VOLATILE_STORAGE: "true"
      # Never read a config.json from the data folder (it would override
      # this environment); this path is on an empty tmpfs.
      CONFIG_FILE: "/run/vaultwarden/config.json"
      SIGNUPS_ALLOWED: "false"
      INVITATIONS_ALLOWED: "true"
      DISABLE_ICON_DOWNLOAD: "true"
      ICON_CACHE_TTL: "0"
      ICON_SERVICE: "internal"
      PUSH_ENABLED: "false"
      SSO_ENABLED: "false"
      PASSWORD_HINTS_ALLOWED: "false"
      SHOW_PASSWORD_HINT: "false"
      ORG_CREATION_USERS: "none"
      IP_HEADER: "X-Forwarded-For"
      LOG_LEVEL: "warn"
      # ADMIN_TOKEN deliberately unset: admin panel disabled (DECISIONS D-008).

  proxy:
    image: docker.io/library/caddy@sha256:003a97808e781aa9f7e75cc2f43d34d461099031faf5e20faefb9f61126836f0 # 2.11.9-alpine
    user: "1001:1001"
    ports:
      - "443:443"
    environment:
      # Caddy's storage: ACME account, certificates and their private keys.
      # /run is a tmpfs, so all of it exists in memory only.
      HOME: "/run/caddy"
      XDG_DATA_HOME: "/run/caddy/data"
      XDG_CONFIG_HOME: "/run/caddy/config"
    configs:
      - source: caddyfile
        target: /etc/attested-vw/Caddyfile

configs:
  caddyfile:
    content: |
      {
        admin off
        # No listener on port 80.
        auto_https disable_redirects
      }
      snp.facundo.dev {
        # One pinned issuer, so the sidecar knows where the leaf lives.
        # TLS-ALPN-01 only: port 80 is not open.
        tls {
          issuer acme {
            dir https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory
            disable_http_challenge
          }
        }
        handle /.well-known/tee-attestation {
          # Public evidence, no credentials: let a browser verifier page
          # on another origin fetch it.
          header Access-Control-Allow-Origin "*"
          reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8081
        }
        handle {
          reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8080
        }
      }
name: attested-vaultwarden-snp
